summary: I wrote src/main.ts. It builds the forest from three InstancedMesh objects: 8,000 trunks, 8,000 canopies and 2,000 rocks, so 10,000 instances in all. They stand on a 400×400 ground plane. Placement uses a seeded mulberry32 generator, so the forest is the same on every load. Canopies, trunks and rocks each get per-instance colours through `setColorAt`. A single shadow-casting directional light lights the scene, with a hemisphere light as non-shadow fill. Fog is `FogExp2`. The camera orbits slowly at radius 105 and height 55, looking at the centre of the 100×100 forest. It renders in a `requestAnimationFrame` loop and sets `window.__EVAL_READY__` after the first frame. The typecheck passes. I couldn't run `vite build` or view the render here, so I haven't checked how the framing, fog density or shadows look in the browser.
